records.name: Gorontalo
records.summary:
The audited sources document Indonesia's national posture rather than Gorontalo: an October 2025 presidential decree lists "the promotion of LGBTQ+ culture" among non-military national-security threats alongside terrorism, radicalism and drug addiction; legal gender change requires sex-reassignment surgery plus judicial approval; a wave of vigilante mob attacks on trans women on 14-16 July 2026 - most severely more than fifteen people doused, stripped and beaten in Bogor, with footage circulated online - and researchers record markedly hardened anti-queer attitudes since 2016. Provincial moral enforcement is sharpest in Aceh, per the same feature.

Nothing in the audited material shows Gorontalo diverging in either direction: no documented local ordinance, raid wave, protection or service specific to the province. A visitor there is exposed to the national picture - identity not criminalised, visibility treated as a security threat, mob violence met with limited accountability.
